items.title: Has Starbucks (SBUX) Run Too Far Ahead As Fresh 2027 Guidance Resets Valuation?
items.summary: Starbucks (SBUX) is back in focus after reporting fourth quarter and full year results on October 29, 2026, along with fresh 2027 guidance that points to slightly lower revenue as its China business shifts models. The fresh earnings and 2027 outlook arrived after a strong run in Starbucks shares. A 30.9% year to date share price return and a 21.2% one month share price gain point to building momentum as investors reassess both growth prospects and risks.
